heading: Participation of a foreign representative in a case under this title
source_credit: (Added Pub. L. 109–8, title VIII, §801(a), Apr. 20, 2005, 119 Stat. 138.)

versions.heading: Participation of a foreign representative in a case under this title

lines.text: Upon recognition of a foreign proceeding, the foreign representative in the recognized proceeding is entitled to participate as a party in interest in a case regarding the debtor under this title.
